title: Brazil: Gisele Bündchen deepfake Instagram ads
summary: Police in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, working with the financial intelligence unit COAF, arrested four suspects on 1 October 2025 in Operação Modo Selva in an investigation that began in August 2024, after a victim reported an Instagram ad with an altered video of supermodel Gisele Bündchen promoting a skincare product. Another ad used her likeness to promise a giveaway of suitcases, with buyers paying shipping fees for items that never arrived. Investigators found more than 20 million reais (about US$3.9 million) in suspicious funds and froze assets across five states. Most victims lost under 100 reais and did not report it. These are arrests and allegations; no conviction was reported.
